name: @red-cup-engineering/metered-inference-tollbooth
description: Official x402 v2 HTTP payment boundary for one exact RMN inference contract.

scripts.check: node --check src/tollbooth.mjs && node --check src/verify-runtime-admission.mjs && node --check test/tollbooth.test.mjs && node --check test/fixtures/deterministic-provider-executor.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: a structurally valid ActivityStreams Accept<ServiceContract> naming one signed provider Agent Card and carrying one canonical RMN effect bundle that directly embeds that provider's effect, after an official x402 v2 exact payment verifies and settles
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: malformed or nonconforming RMN, mismatched caller/provider/law/composition, any request not settled by the configured x402 facilitator, or any request for a registry-selected provider, EOA fallback, custom payment envelope, or unsigned execution

serve-metered-inference.accepts: POST application/activity+json after official x402 v2 exact settlement
